fullPassage: The emphasis on learning from the ingroup takes little account of individuals. Amazingly, while we may dislike some of the people in our ingroup, we still copy them. Wilks, Kirby, and Nielsen studied copying behavior in the context of observing how to open a puzzle box. Ingroups and outgroups were distinguished in a minimal way, using simple color coding of wristbands. The children did not simply like all members of their ingroup; they disliked those who behaved in an antisocial fashion. Indeed, they liked these antisocial ingroup members less than the prosocial members of an outgroup. Still, their dislike did not affect their tendency to copy ingroup behavior more closely than outgroup behavior. This overimitation reveals that we are not copying in order to learn how to open a box most efficiently. We want to learn how to do it in the proper way — in other words, __________. This will be appropriately demonstrated even by antisocial ingroup members.

❌ ② 또래 관계가 아닌 모방 메커니즘
❌ ③ 반사회적 행동의 영향이 아님
❌ ④ 효율성이 아닌 규범
det.tip: 주제: ingroup copying regardless of personal feelings

questions.passage: The emphasis on learning from the ingroup takes little account of individuals. Amazingly, while we may dislike some of the people in our ingroup, we still copy them. Wilks, Kirby, and Nielsen studied copying behavior in the context of observing how to open a puzzle box. Ingroups and outgroups were distinguished in a minimal way, using simple color coding of wristbands. The children did not simply like all members of their ingroup; they disliked those who behaved in an antisocial fashion. Indeed, they liked these antisocial ingroup members less than the prosocial members of an outgroup. Still, their dislike did not affect their tendency to copy ingroup behavior more closely than outgroup behavior. This overimitation reveals that we are not copying in order to learn how to open a box most efficiently. We want to learn how to do it in the proper way — in other words, __________. This will be appropriately demonstrated even by antisocial ingroup members.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 효율적인 학습을 위해 다양한 모방 전략을 사용해야 한다.
반사회적 행동을 하는 구성원은 집단에서 배제해야 한다.
사람들은 효율성이 아닌 내집단 규범을 따르기 위해 모방한다.
호감이 높은 사람의 행동만 모방하는 것이 바람직하다.

det.korean: 모방 = 효율 X, 내집단 규범 O
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 내집단 규범을 위한 모방
❌ ① 효율이 아닌 규범
❌ ② 배제가 아닌 여전히 모방
❌ ④ 호감 무관하게 모방
det.tip: 요지: copy for conformity, not efficiency
